extracted.intended_audience: Federal agency officials and component managers responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-120 (consulting services compliance and reporting)
extracted.subtask_description: Completing and returning a questionnaire documenting an agency's implementation of OMB Circular A-120 (Consulting Services), including documentation, data on competitive vs. noncompetitive awards, definitions, controls, and any evaluations. Responses may be consolidated or provided per component and are expected to reflect current practices and FY1985 unless noted otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respondent identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Who is answering the following questions on Circular A-120? Name: Title: Telephone number:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the name, title, and telephone number of the person completing the questionnaire for traceability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency official responsible for implementing A-120
rubrics_metrics.description: Who is the agency official responsible for implementing A-120? Name: Title: Telephone number:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the agency official with implementation responsibility so the working group can follow up if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existence and nature of regulations/internal guidelines for consulting services
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the agency have regulations or internal guidelines to be followed in arranging for consulting services? (No; Yes, agency internal guidelines — attach a copy; Yes, codified regulations — provide CFR cite.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If internal guidelines exist attach copy. If codified, provide the CFR citation. The questionnaire asks whether these regulations are a supplement to the government-wide FAR (Yes/No).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data availability on noncompetitively-awarded consulting contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Are data available on the number of noncompetitively-awarded consulting contracts? (No; Yes — what percent were/are noncompetitive awards: % 5 years ago or don't know; % now)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide historical and current percentages if available; otherwise indicate 'don't know' or 'No'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controls to ensure competitive awarding of consulting contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Are there controls to ensure that the maximum practicable number of consulting contracts are awarded competitively? (No; Yes — in codified regulations: provide CFR cite; Yes — in agency internal directives/guidelines: attach copy; Yes — in other ways: specify.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, specify where controls are documented and attach relevant materials or describe other mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of controls used for competitive awards
rubrics_metrics.description: What do these controls include? (check all that apply) Usual clearances/sign-offs; Special clearances/sign-offs; Approval by a more senior level official than for competitive awards; Other — specify.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check all applicable control types and provide details for 'Other' entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting consulting service data to central systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the agency make sure that appropriate data on consulting services are provided to: a) OPM's Central Personnel Date File (for personnel appointments)? b) the Federal Procurement Data System (for contracts)? c) to GSA in accordance with GSA interim regulations on Advisory committees?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer Yes/No for each reporting destination and supply any supporting documentation if requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centralized retention of consulting service data
rubrics_metrics.description: Are the data provided in a, b, and c kept centrally? (No; Yes — Where? Please provide building and room number.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If data are maintained centrally, specify the central location (building/room) and provide contact information or references to the central repository.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mutual exclusivity and deduplication of data
rubrics_metrics.description: Are the data provided in a, b, and c mutually exclusive to ensure that the agency's total number of consultants is accurate and non-duplicative? (Yes; No — Please explain any duplication.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If duplication exists, explain causes and any reconciliation procedures to produce accurate total consultant counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency definition/scope of 'consultants'
rubrics_metrics.description: Who is included in the agency's definition of consultants? Please describe the scope of the agency's interpretation of A-120 and attach any written material on this point.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the agency's working definition, scope, and any written policies or guidance that clarify which individuals/arrangements are treated as 'consultants' under A-120.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existence of GAO or agency IG evaluations under A-120
rubrics_metrics.description: Are there any GAO or agency IG evaluations of agency performance under A-120? (Yes — please attach a copy; No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach copies of audits, evaluations, or reports where available; if none exist, indicate 'No'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Component-level responses where significant variations exist
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare a separate questionnaire for each Component when significant variations may exist among systems and practices; clearly identify the components to which replies refer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Large departments (e.g., DOD, DHHS) should submit separate replies for operating components whose practices differ materially, to avoid misleading consolidated responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeframe and assumptions for responses
rubrics_metrics.description: In replying to individual questions, the working group will assume that your responses relate to current practices and the immediate past fiscal year -- FY 1985 -- unless there is an indication to the contrary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State explicitly if responses refer to a different period; otherwise answers should reflect current practice and FY1985.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment and documentation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach two copies of all relevant agency documentation to your response where documentation is requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where the questionnaire asks for regulations, directives, audits, or other documents, include two copies as requested to facilitate review and consolidation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission deadline and recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Please complete the questionnaire for your component only and return to me NLT COB Friday, April 25, so I can consolidate the responses. Send replies to: Directorate for Management Improvement OASD(C) MS Room 1B728. (Other memos request replies to OMB within four weeks and to Barbara Young-Kahlow, OMB, Room 10215 NEOB.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe the stated deadlines and send responses to the named office/person; use the specified addresses and contact numbers for questions (e.g., Diane Bray, Frank Haendler).

rubrics_metrics.name: Working group assessment and potential on-site verification
rubrics_metrics.description: The working group will assess implementation by analyzing completed questionnaires and agency practices and procedures -- regulations, internal control systems, guidance, etc. -- and will, on a spot basis, make on-site visits to agencies to verify and supplement information submitted in the questionnaires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be prepared for spot on-site visits and ensure documentation and practices described in the questionnaire can be substantiated.
